docs.summary: Defines a cursor lock context where the cursor locks to, and whether locking is allowed. Contexts are stacked via Input.PushLockContext / PopLockContext. The topmost context controls cursor lock behavior.
Whether cursor locking is allowed in this context.
Returns the screen-space position the cursor should be locked to. Override for custom centering behavior (e.g., center of a panel instead of window).

Returns the inclusive window-space rect [`Confined`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.CursorLockMode~Confined) holds the cursor inside. Override to confine to something smaller than the window (e.g. an editor panel).
